def generate_title(pkg: str, remediation: Dict[str, Any], vulns: List[Dict[
    str, Any]]) ->str:
    vuln_count = len(vulns)
    vuln_word = "vulnerability" if vuln_count == 1 else "vulnerabilities"
    
    if 'requirement' in remediation and 'specifier' in remediation['requirement']:
        specifier = remediation['requirement']['specifier']
        recommended_version = remediation['recommended_version']
        return f"Update {pkg} from {specifier} to {recommended_version} to fix {vuln_count} {vuln_word}"
    else:
        from_version = remediation['version'] if remediation['version'] else "unknown"
        recommended_version = remediation['recommended_version']
        return f"Update {pkg} from {from_version} to {recommended_version} to fix {vuln_count} {vuln_word}"
